title: Case 025: Premium balance notification — 125 Willow Walk, Brackenford
initial_request: I’ve just been told there may be an unpaid amount on my property policy for 125 Willow Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 7ZZ. Please check what I owe, when it is due and how I can pay securely.
overview: Northmere Mutual’s financial team told Iris Vale at Millcroft Cover that George Lane owed £286.40, due within 10 calendar days of the insurer’s notice, and could pay through the insurer’s secure account portal. Iris relayed those details to George, who confirmed receipt and said he had paid through that channel. Northmere Mutual’s financial team subsequently confirmed the payment status to Iris, who passed the confirmation to George.

next_action.summary: Notify George of the specific £286.40 balance, the insurer’s 10-calendar-day payment deadline and the permitted secure payment route, then seek a finance-team status check after he reports payment.

outcome: George was notified of the £286.40 balance, its 10-calendar-day deadline and the permitted payment method; Northmere Mutual’s financial team later confirmed that the payment had been received and the balance was settled.

events.body: Our records show an outstanding property-policy balance of £286.40 for George Lane at 125 Willow Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 7ZZ. Payment is due within 10 calendar days of this notice and may be made through Northmere Mutual’s secure account portal.

Northmere Mutual has advised that £286.40 remains due on your property policy, with payment due within 10 calendar days of its notice. The insurer says the permitted payment method is its secure account portal; I’m passing on its details so you can review and act on them.

Thanks, I’ve received the balance and deadline details. I’ve now made the payment through Northmere Mutual’s secure account portal, but please let me know once its finance team has confirmed the status.
George has reported paying the £286.40 balance through your secure account portal. Could you please check the account and confirm the current payment status?
We have confirmed receipt of George Lane’s £286.40 payment. The balance is now settled on the account.
Northmere Mutual’s financial team has confirmed receipt of your £286.40 payment and advised that the balance is now settled on the account. This confirms the current payment status.
